name: In-block shuffle and coalesced mapping
aliases: In-block shuffle radix counting with coalesced cluster-wise mapping
definition: A strategy to address non-coalesced writing by performing local shuffling in shared memory to cluster same-radix elements, followed by coalesced cluster-wise mapping to global memory.
summary: In-block shuffle and coalesced mapping clusters same-radix elements in shared memory to enable coalesced global memory writes, avoiding the random scattering penalties of standard element-wise mapping.
